text:
nora: Heads-up: were announcing an artifact rename for the Go SDK today. Package path will change from `github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk` to `github.com/redwoodinc/redwood-go` to align with multi-repo packaging. This affects imports only; runtime behavior unchanged.

devin: Timeline? Any breaking changes?

nora: TL;DR: non-breaking for 30 days via go mod replace shim in the old repo, then 90-day deprecation warnings in docs, remove old package path in 180 days. We'll publish a compatibility shim and a migration guide.

kevin: Engineering: we'll add a small shim module that re-exports types so `import "github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk"` continues to compile but emits a build-time deprecation notice via go vet directive. CI will test both import paths for 90 days.

maya: Docs plan: top-level banner, migration snippet, and update quickstarts. I'll add a small script for maintainers: `scripts/replace-imports.sh` sample. Draft by tomorrow.

docs-bot: Published: docs PR #4310 by maya - "go: artifact path rename and migration guide (WIP)" (automated).

devin: Support ask: prepare a 2-line TL;DR for customer emails + one-sheeter for partner integrators. Also flag enterprise Dedicated customers for manual reach-out.

nora: Agree. We'll coordinate comms: blog post + email + changelog entry. Ops will keep old runtime images for 12 months.

kevin: Migration example for docs:
```go
// old import (legacy)
import "github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk"

// new import (recommended)
import "github.com/redwoodinc/redwood-go"

client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```
Note: if you use modules, `go get github.com/redwoodinc/redwood-go@v1.0.0` is enough.

maya: I'll add a compatibility matrix and a short FAQ (how to detect old imports, CI errors, rollback steps).

nora: OK thanks. Action owners: kevin -> shim + CI; maya -> docs + banners; devin -> comms + customer list. Ping me if there are large customers to escalate. :thumbsup:
